title: TradeFile
description: YAML frontmatter schema for one file under trades/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<PAIR>-<seq>.md. This single record serves as the Journal entry, the Edge Log entry, and (if flagged) a Mistake DB entry per SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 8. The Markdown body below the frontmatter holds the full Decision Output (master spec section 23) and, once closed, the Post-Trade Review (section 26).

setup_type.description: e.g. Wyckoff Spring Type 2, Liquidity Sweep Reversal, Trend Continuation

rehearsal_mode.description: true if this trade record came from a MOCK-data rehearsal run, not a live decision. Rehearsal trades must never be counted in the consecutive-loss throttle or Edge Log win-rate rollups.

confluence_score.description: DecisionAgent score; null for rules-only pilot trades (no confluence engine ran)

position_size.description: base-asset units from RiskSkill; null until a position size has actually been approved (e.g. NO_TRADE/WAIT rehearsals)

is_mistake.description: set true so this record surfaces in the Mistake-DB rollup view

market.description: venue the trade was executed on; demo/testnet trades are excluded from nothing but labelled everywhere

source.description: who produced the record: /analyze pipeline, the rules-only demo pilot, or a hand entry

session.description: killzone/session of the entry (docs/TTrades PDFs/1. Killzones.pdf); derived from entry time in UTC

planned_rr.description: reward:risk at plan time (target1 vs stop)

pnl_usd.description: realised P&L in quote currency, fees included when known

slippage_bps.description: (actual fill - planned entry)/planned entry in basis points, signed against the trade

thesis.description: one paragraph: why this trade, in Wyckoff/ICT terms, with the facts it rested on

plan_vs_actual.description: what differed between the plan (entry/stop/target/size/timing) and what was executed

followed_plan.description: false whenever any rule of the plan was broken (early exit, moved stop, oversized, chased entry)

confidence.description: pre-trade confidence 1–5, recorded before the outcome is known

emotional_state.description: free text for the human trader (calm / FOMO / revenge / tired…); leave empty for pilot trades

screenshots.description: paths or URLs of chart captures at entry/exit

review_notes.description: post-trade review: what the market actually did vs the thesis

what_to_change.description: the single concrete change for next time (rule, filter, sizing, timing); feeds learning-agent
